items.title: How Big Could Fair Isaac Stock's Next Fall Be?
items.summary: Fair Isaac (FICO) stock fell 27% in the past month with no company news to explain it. Equifax and TransUnion fell more than 20% too. If you hold the shares, you may wonder what a full market shock would do to them. Fair Isaac's record in past shocks can size the next fall, but only if the company that fell then is yours. So is today's Fair Isaac the same company that fell in past shocks.

items.title: Is Fair Isaac Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
items.summary: Fair Isaac (FICO), the maker of the FICO Score, beats Equifax, TransUnion and three other peers on revenue growth and operating margin. Yet its stock lost 59.3% over the past twelve months, the worst return in the group. So after that fall, is Fair Isaac stock worth more than its competitors.
